scientific_integrity: The proof concerns a normalized squared weighted Bergman norm with exactly four unit-residue boundary poles; the power exponent is positive. The unique transition is analytically proved; finite checks are supplementary. The numerical crossover is approximate and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Not a global quadratic stability bound
No assertion for other numbers of poles or unequal pole residues
Weight threshold is characterized implicitly; numerical root is approximate
title: A unique angular-stability transition for four weighted Bergman poles
